Cache transfer is about how data moves between the cache and main memory. Role switching might refer to different roles (like CPU or GPU) being assigned to different nodes. Batch completion is when multiple requests are processed in a batch, which affects throughput. GPU utilization is how much GPU resources are being used, which impacts both latency and throughput. Throughput tradeoffs are the balance between processing speed and resource usage.
